reason: cdeb-fresh-v6 is the final planned study of this research line. It measures the product effect on the exact population cdeb-fresh-v5 made measurable: 34 functionally violable historical decisions in the two repositories whose acceptance instruments were deterministic under the frozen configuration. v5 reached TERMINAL_HOLD with zero product-effect rows and is preserved as history; v3, v3r1 and v4 are terminal and none may be resumed or named here. v6 reuses v5 evidence only as planning input -- decision identity, audit anchor, frozen snapshot, and the pre-treatment violability classification -- and no v5 task, patch, oracle, randomization or row. A successor after v6 requires a separate owner decision and is not generated automatically.
